title: Bitter, chemical smelling coffee
text:
Bitter, chemical smelling coffee. The coffee is not good! It has a bitter taste and a weird smell. It doesn't even smell like coffee. It's so bad we can't even finish one cup no matter how much cream you put in it. We bought an expensive burr grinder and tried different sizes of grinds and different beans. We tried cleaning it with the descaling solution and then a vinegar solution when that didn't seem to help; the water reservoir and coffee pot always had a chemical smell to it. We wonder if the plastic is BPA free. The machine itself is so light - lighter than our 25 year old MR Coffee that makes better coffee. The Bonavita feels cheap and smells weird and the coffee pot smells skunky with a hint of metal and it is without a doubt some of the worst coffee we have ever tasted and perhaps the worst.

We want our money back. This is a piece of crap.
